mcqs.question: What did GOLD 2023 do with the old C and D groups?

options.A: Merged them into group E, for exacerbations
options.C: Renamed them group Z for fibrosis

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Merged them into group E, for exacerbations
mcqs.explanation: Former C and D are merged into group E. Groups A and B remain.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: GOLD / Am J Respir Crit Care Med
sourceRefs.excerpt: the former C and D groups are now merged into a single group termed “E” (for “Exacerbations”)

mcqs.question: What initial therapy does GOLD 2023 recommend for group E, and what is the eosinophil exception?

options.A: LAMA+LABA, unless eosinophils are at least 300 cells/μL, when triple therapy can be considered
options.E: Triple therapy is forbidden if eosinophils are high

mcqs.correctAnswerText: LAMA+LABA, unless eosinophils are at least 300 cells/μL, when triple therapy can be considered
mcqs.explanation: Group E starts with LAMA+LABA except when blood eosinophils are at least 300 cells/μL, when triple therapy can be considered.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: GOLD / Am J Respir Crit Care Med
sourceRefs.excerpt: For patients in Group E, LAMA + LABA is also the recommended initial therapy, except for those patients with blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/μl, in whom starting triple therapy (LABA + LAMA + ICS) can be considered.

mcqs.question: What does the summary say about the symptom and exacerbation thresholds used on the axes?

options.A: They are unchanged from previous GOLD documents
options.D: Exacerbations in the previous week replace the previous year

mcqs.correctAnswerText: They are unchanged from previous GOLD documents
mcqs.explanation: Symptom and previous-year exacerbation thresholds are unchanged, which is why A and B stay the same.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: GOLD / Am J Respir Crit Care Med
sourceRefs.excerpt: The thresholds proposed for symptoms ( x -axis) and history of exacerbations in the previous year ( y -axis) are unchanged

mcqs.question: What does GOLD 2023 say about the practical value of the ABE proposal?

options.A: It needs validation in clinical research
options.B: It is already proven to reduce mortality by a stated percentage

mcqs.correctAnswerText: It needs validation in clinical research
mcqs.explanation: The summary says the practical value needs to be validated by appropriate clinical research.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: GOLD / Am J Respir Crit Care Med
sourceRefs.excerpt: The practical value of this proposal needs to be validated by appropriate clinical research.

mcqs.question: How does the summary characterise the airflow obstruction of COPD?
mcqs.explanation: COPD is described as persistent, often progressive airflow obstruction from airway and/or alveolar abnormalities.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: GOLD / Am J Respir Crit Care Med
